# QR Code Generator (vendored)

Used by `/static/explainer-scenes.js` for the `qr` scene of the program explainers: the QR code
is drawn in the browser from the official study-plan URL, so the robot screen needs no CDN and
no internet to show it.

| File | Source | Version |
|---|---|---|
| `qrcode.js` | npm package `qrcode-generator` (https://unpkg.com/qrcode-generator@1.4.4/qrcode.js) | 1.4.4 |
| `LICENSE` | https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator/blob/master/LICENSE | MIT |
